subject.title: fix(agents): avoid synthetic overflow in tool-heavy sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt provider rejection as the authority for whole-session context-overflow recovery across aggregate, preflight, and tool-loop heuristic-pressure paths?
rationale: The branch fixes the reported false-positive compaction path, but it intentionally changes the recovery policy beyond the narrower aggregate-only alternative and affects persisted session-history behavior.

options.title: Adopt provider-authoritative recovery
options.body: Accept the broader policy after confirming the caller/session ownership split preserves bounded recovery for every supported runtime.

options.title: Keep the aggregate-only mitigation
options.body: Prefer the narrower open alternative in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107821 and retain the existing preflight and tool-loop recovery authority.

recommendation.title: Adopt provider-authoritative recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the broader policy after confirming the caller/session ownership split preserves bounded recovery for every supported runtime.
